text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,870.65, up 0.25% on the day, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.73% to 22,684.6. Gains were modest but broad‑based: 311 stocks advanced versus 183 declines, and the breadth score sat at 58.9 in a neutral zone. About two‑thirds of the Nifty 500 remain above the 20‑day moving average, indicating the rally still has support.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding INR 6,836.81 crore, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold INR 3,678.85 crore, extending a five‑day buying streak for FIIs and a three‑day selling streak for DIIs. The leading sectors were Infrastructure, Capital Markets, Pharma, FMCG, Oil & Gas, Consumption, Healthcare and Realty, whereas IT, Media, Private Bank and Financial Services showed weakening. In the options market, Nifty’s put‑call ratio (PCR) is 0.98, max‑pain sits at 23,800, with a call wall at 24,000 and a put wall at 23,000; Bank Nifty’s PCR is 1.01, max‑pain at 55,700, call wall at 58,000 and put wall at 55,000.

Watch the 23,825–23,950 range for Nifty and 55,400–56,800 for Bank Nifty as the expected zones. Key levels to monitor are the Nifty pivot points (S1 23,725.15, P 23,835.75, R1 23,975.35) and the 200‑day moving average at 24,008.23. A break below the put wall (23,000) or the Bank Nifty put wall (55,000) could signal further downside, while staying above the call walls would support the current uptrend.
